HelpingHand

Putting Robotics Within Every Student's Grasp

A robotic hand kit with lessons. Students ages 11 and up design it, wire it, and program it themselves. About $150 in parts for one hand.

Build one finger.

Start with a guide. Assemble the links, connect the motor, and watch the joints curl together.

See what moves.

The kit

One finger first. Then the whole hand.

Each finger is its own module with its own motor. A class starts with one finger in Lesson 1. The whole hand is four fingers and a thumb.
